items.text: fixed (iPhone): the heads-up display arrows showed the next pane and then slid back about a second later. Snapping to panes is now paused while the page slides to one and resumed where it lands.
fixed: the Sounds tab at the top of the heads-up display now shows the same wave icon as the field button in the bar, instead of the old one.

fixed: the heads-up display arrows (and the tabs) no longer slide a little and snap back. A re-align during the slide pulled the page back to the pane it had left; the remembered pane now moves with the tap.

fixed: the heads-up display arrows are back to their old narrow width (the tab icons were pushed off) and now step on release, with the touch kept for the button, so a fingertip that drifts a little still counts.
fixed: the heads-up display's left and right arrows now count every tap, even while the pane is still sliding (quick taps used to be lost), and they are wider (46 px) with no tap delay.
changed: the calm start (20 bpm, golden split of rows and columns) is only for a first visit. After that the tempo and which rows and columns play are kept, so a reload brings back what you left.
changed: the opening grid uses a golden split: 62% of the rows play and 38% of the columns, or the other way round, chosen at random each load.
changed: a calmer first start. Tempo opens at 20 bpm, and only about four in ten rows and columns play, chosen at random, so the grid is sparse and slow. Everything can still be changed as before.
